answer: Each agent must stake a unique proof-of-work bound to a hardware root key, and every epoch it submits a fresh cipher challenge whose solution depends on the prior epoch's state. Forging identities means redoing the full chain of work, costing far more than the reward. Peers sample the ledger like timber cores, rejecting duplicates, while the tundra of idle fake nodes starves without stake. This makes sybil attacks economically self-defeating, since each new reputation slot demands real capital and computation. The Agent0261 deployment anchors trust at NrtLNpN9AR.
